description: ReverseGPT humanizes AI-generated text so it reads naturally while preserving meaning, facts, and formatting. It supports up to 1,000 words per call, optional Ultra processing for eligible plans, and free polling for unfinished jobs. Credit-based plans use one ReverseGPT credit per input word. Max includes humanization without deducting credits. Credits deducted for failed runs are refunded.
